summary: Frontend E2E test of the new 'Twins orfane' repair action inside the Data Integrity Card (Admin AI Console). Full flow works end-to-end: login → /admin?tab=ai → run scan → 'Twins orfane' shown as failing with 1 orphan → click delete-all → confirm panel with protection message → confirm-yes → result message shown ('Șterse (arhivate): 1 · sărite: 0 · eșuate: 0. Twins orfane rămase: 0.') → auto re-scan → Twins orfane check now OK and orphan-twins-actions panel is gone. Report summary went from '21 probleme detectate · 5/9 verificări OK' to '20 probleme detectate · 6/9 verificări OK', proving real DB change (not masked).

issues: The success result message (data-testid='orphan-twins-result', 'Șterse (arhivate): 1 ... Twins orfane rămase: 0.') is rendered INSIDE the conditional block `!c.ok && c.name === 'Twins orfane'`. After the auto re-scan, the check becomes OK, so the entire orphan-twins-actions block unmounts and the success toast/message disappears immediately. The user briefly sees it (during the ~1s re-scan) but it is gone after. LOW priority — flow works and DB change is verifiable via the summary going from 21→20 issues and the check turning green, but ideally the success feedback should persist as a standalone toast/banner independent of the failed-check block.

action_items: Optional UX polish: move the orphan-twins result message outside the `!c.ok` conditional block so the success confirmation ('Șterse (arhivate): 1 · Twins orfane rămase: 0.') persists after the auto re-scan turns the check green. Currently it disappears as soon as re-scan completes.
critical_code_review_comments: DataIntegrityCard.jsx line 202-206: `resolveMsg` is only rendered inside the Twins-orfane failing branch. After successful resolve + re-scan the branch unmounts and the confirmation vanishes. Consider lifting the result banner to card-level.
resolveOrphanTwins does not clear `resolveMsg` on subsequent manual re-runs of `run()` — mostly fine but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: None — used the 1 synthetic orphan twin already seeded by main agent. After this test run the orphan count is 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 1 seeded orphan twin was consumed by this UI test. If re-testing, main agent must re-seed a synthetic orphan (insert a twins doc with a random non-existent property_id) so the 'Twins orfane' check fails again and the delete-all button re-appears. Otherwise the Twins orfane check will already show OK/0 and the orphan-twins-actions area will not render.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works as specified. Only minor UX note about result message lifecycle.
